name: get_session_state
description: Fetch authoritative state before a workout action. Read-only.

name: get_exercise_guidance
description: Fetch curated catalog setup, cues, muscles and common mistakes. Read-only; no observed-form claims.

exercise_id.description: Catalog exercise ID returned by the authoritative current snapshot; never an instance ID.
exercise_id.title: Exercise Id

name: submit_workout_action
description: Submit one explicit user-requested action and wait for success. Never retry against a new target after rejection.

exercise_instance_id.description: Current instance_id; null only for end_session or retry_deferred.
exercise_instance_id.title: Exercise Instance Id

set_index.description: Current 1-based set index; null for session-level actions.
set_index.title: Set Index
